items.raw_snippet:
Can AI help with post-merger integration in finance?
:   Yes, for the data work. A model can suggest a group account for each target account from its name, description and posting history, and flag intercompany flows that do not match. The group controller approves each suggestion, and only approved rules run at the close. The model does not post entries or decide accounting treatment.

Financial Intelligence

## See it working onyour numbers [...] IFRS 3 defines the acquisition date as the date the buyer obtains control, generally the closing date. IFRS 10 requires the group to include the subsidiary's income and expenses in its consolidated financial statements from that date. US GAAP (ASC 805 and ASC 810) uses the same start date. A deal closing on March 16 enters the March group close with 16 days of results. [...] A US domestic SEC registrant also has a filing clock. For a significant acquisition, Form 8-K is due four business days after closing. Any required target financial statements and pro forma information follow within 71 calendar days after that. For a March 16, 2026 closing, the 8-K is due March 20. The 71st day falls on a Saturday, so the filing moves to Monday, June 1, which is Day 78 if the closing day counts as Day 1.
